arStrings.szText: Sight Thrice Paid
Despite a divine warning to abandon the Eye, Seer Athrpa remains determined to restore it.

We have a lead. Seer Laurel's vision described a waterfall, which might lead to the fabled vault where Philios locked away the Eye. I should travel there with Athrpa and see if this place truly exists.
Speak with Seer Athrpa

The first attempt to restore the Eye failed, but Seer Athrpa is not ready to give up. Not even a warning from Lycander will dissuade her. Athrpa believes there is another way to harness the artifact's power. I should meet her in Vision's End to find out more.
